caption: The robot moved the red cube from the green tray to the table. At second 0, the cube was in the tray (occupied). At second 14, it was on the table (unobstructed). The robot did not return it.

The robot picked up the red cube at second 4 from the green tray (unoccupied). It moved it to above the tray (unoccupied) by second 8. It then returned the red cube to the green tray by second 12, which was unoccupied. The blue cube remained unmoved.

The robot’s gripper moved slightly, grasping the red cube at second 0. At second 14, it remains holding the red cube over the same spot. The source (red cube’s original position) and destination (green tray) are both unobstructed at both times. The cube was not moved away or returned.

The robot moved the red cube from beside the green tray to inside it. At second 0, the red cube was on the table, unobstructed. At second 14, it was inside the green tray, which was unobstructed. The blue cube remained unmoved.

The robot moved the blue cube from left of the red cube to inside the green tray. At second 0, the blue cube was unoccupied. At second 14, the blue cube is inside the green tray, which is occupied. The red cube remains unoccupied at both times.

No visible object movement occurred between second 0 and second 14. All objects remained in identical positions. Source and destination areas were unoccupied and unobstructed throughout. No object was moved away or returned.
